title: alnus viridis f. laciniata
intro: Alnus viridis f. laciniata, commonly known as the green alder or mountain alder, is a subspecies of the alder tree (Alnus viridis). It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to mountainous regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. The green alder is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Alnus viridis f. laciniata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
